severity.kind: Descriptive symptom-severity bands, not diagnosis or percentile norms
severity.source_locator: Original article discussion: lower limits 5,10,15,20; 0–4 residual none/minimal band.
severity.population: Original US clinical adult study, not Chinese norms.

screening.target: Possible major depression for further clinical assessment
screening.scope: Original clinical criterion-validation sample only; no claim of accuracy for all users, Chinese translations or adolescents.

referenceProfiles.norms: No population norms or percentiles approved.
referenceProfiles.longitudinal: May describe within-person score changes with consistent form/language/recall period; do not claim a validated treatment response or minimal important difference from these packages.

referenceStudy.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The PHQ-9: Validity of a Brief Depression Severity Measure. Journal of General Internal Medicine. 2001;16(9):606–613.
referenceStudy.access_note: Publicly indexed full text verified through primary-source search; direct PMC fetch currently presents browser challenge and Wiley direct fetch returned 403. Do not describe direct retrieval as successful. No article file copied.
referenceStudy.article_reuse_status: LINK_ONLY: article copyright/repository redistribution grant not established; later instrument permission is not an article license.
referenceStudy.evidence_summary: Development validation: 6,000 patients across eight primary-care and seven obstetrics/gynecology clinics; criterion interview subgroup 580 primary-care patients. Threshold >=10: sensitivity 88%, specificity 88% for major depression against independent mental-health-professional interview. Severity lower bounds 5,10,15,20. These are not population norms or a self-administered diagnosis.
